result.topic_en: Extension of the arithmetic-geometric mean sequences to the left (backwards), showing the behaviour of the two two-sided progressions and stating that the AGM of any corresponding pair of terms equals that of a and b.

poterunt $'a$, $''a$, $'''a$ etc. spectari tamquam continuatio progressionis superioris versus laeuam, atque $'b, ''b, '''b$ etc. tamquam continuatio progressionis inferioris, ita vt iam habeantur duae progressiones vtrimque in infinitum continuabiles
$\ldots\ldots {}^{IV}a,\ '''a,\ ''a,\ 'a,\ a,\ a',\ a'',\ a''',\ a^{IV}\ldots\ldots$ (I)
$\ldots\ldots {}^{IV}b,\ '''b,\ ''b,\ 'b,\ b,\ b',\ b'',\ b''',\ b^{IV}\ldots\ldots$ (II)
Quiuis itaque terminus progressionis (I) erit maior quam correspondens seriei (II); series illa a laeua ad dextram continuo decrescit, a dextra ad laeuam crescit; haec a laeua ad dextram continuo crescit sensuque contrario decrescit. Versus dextram vtraque series eundem limitem habet; versus laeuam autem (I) super omnes limites crescit, (II) habet limitem 0 (nisi omnes vtriusque progressionis termini sunt aequales). Nam $'a = a + \sqrt{(aa-bb)}$, [-$'b = a + \sqrt{(aa-bb)}$-] {+$'b = a - \sqrt{(aa-bb)}$+}; hinc $'a'a - 'b'b = 4a\sqrt{(aa-bb)} > 4(aa-bb)$, similiterque $''a''a - ''b''b > 4('a'a - 'b'b)$ etc., vnde patet, seriem $aa-bb$, $'a'a-'b'b$, $''a''a-''b''b$ etc. et proin etiam hanc $a, 'a, ''a$ etc. quemuis limitem superare posse; $\frac{'b}{b} = \frac{b}{'a} < \frac{b}{a}$ similiterque $\frac{''b}{'b} < \frac{'b}{'a}$ etc. i.e. $\frac{{}^{n+1}b}{{}^{n}b}$ infra quemuis limitem deprimi potest augendo ipsum $n$, adeoque limes seriei $b, 'b, ''b$ etc. $= 0$.
Ex definitione numeri medii arithmetico geometrici tam manifestum est vt explicatione ampliori iam non opus sit sequens
THEOREMA. Numerus medius inter terminos quoscunque correspondentes progressionum I, II idem est ac inter $a$ et $b$.
3. Quo clarius perspiciatur, quanta rapiditate series (I) et (II) ad dextram versus limitem suum approximent, et quomodo versus laeuam

methods.what: Backward extension of the AGM iteration: given a, b, the preceding pair is a ± sqrt(a^2 - b^2)
Inequality showing the squared differences grow at least fourfold going left
Ratio of successive b terms going left is decreasing, so the b-terms tend to 0
Invariance of the AGM along the progressions
methods.quote: THEOREMA. Numerus medius inter terminos quoscunque correspondentes progressionum I, II idem est ac inter $a$ et $b$.

items.quote: versus laeuam autem (I) super omnes limites crescit, (II) habet limitem 0 (nisi omnes vtriusque progressionis termini sunt aequales)
items.english: but toward the left (I) grows beyond all bounds, and (II) has limit 0 (unless all terms of both progressions are equal).

items.quote: THEOREMA. Numerus medius inter terminos quoscunque correspondentes progressionum I, II idem est ac inter $a$ et $b$.
items.english: THEOREM. The mean between any corresponding terms of the progressions I, II is the same as that between a and b.

items.quote: 3. Quo clarius perspiciatur, quanta rapiditate series (I) et (II) ad dextram versus limitem suum approximent, et quomodo versus laeuam
items.english: 3. So that it may be seen more clearly how rapidly the series (I) and (II) approach their limit toward the right, and how toward the left
